📢ANOTHER UNTRUSTWORTHY CASINO OUT THE GAMBLING SPACE. ᡕᠵデᡁ᠊╾━💥🌐👋

Time to Expose @Winna, @Drunk_, @bennettwinna & most of their joke of a team. Please. Stay. Away.

I've been working with Winna for some months now, and recently got my deal cut off abruptly with zero notice or reasoning what so ever, I should of left them much sooner. Not much to expect from a site with such poor reputation whether it's faking reviews, provably fair issues or even what I'm about to expose even more.

These last months working with this casino have been hell. on. earth. And even players can agree. Let's start with the beginning. I was offered a decent deal by @Drunk_ to start the site after leaving Menace, a bullshit casino I exposed aswell that went out of business shortly after. Things were going smooth at first, good rewards for me, transfers for my players, deal wise, a smooth partnership obviously with long term intentions. Months pass by & the casino starts to slowly get worse and worse. Allegations from players pile in, drama starts, rewards get worse & worse, & even @Drunk_ (the affiliate manager)'s colors start to show.

I'm all about scaling & brainstorming with the casino I work with but it was the complete opposite with Winna. I was only given contact to Drunk regarding higher ups on Winna, and absolutely nobody else on Winna would respond to me. And he was absolute hell to work with the list goes on, short temper, unprofessionalism, a lying manipulator, delaying payments, delaying leaderboard payments, never communicating, shutting down transfers, predatory markers for him just to get his loans, he would do anything during the day BUT his job.

The entire team was a joke, I would get inaccurate statistics from my players most of the time when asked, reloads shut down, lossback lowered, rewards lowered in general, statistic workers going inactive for days on end, it was an absolute shit show.

Going back deal wise, it's not the first time this has happened, I was extremely profitable for them dozens, tens of millions of dollars wagered onto the site from my players, me making absolutely nothing in pay down well over a million dollars from my account alone. Not counting ALL the other benefits taking into account in a partnership in general regarding exposure, marketing, and so on. And it would be so common for them to delay a weeks payment or leaderboard for days on end for "negotiation" reasons with absolutely zero calls, talking with me, negotiations on my end whatsoever. They could ignore you for days on end with zero information and lower your deal for absolutely no reason. And if you argue about it, he would threaten to end the entire deal, tell you to shut the fuck up, calm down and be more professional. When you try to get contact with the owner to see what the reasonings are he simply wouldn't let you and yet claim he has no information.

The guy even deleted the entire chat history trying to erase evidence on our telegram chats for months specifically after an arguement, and even when I confronted him he would lie STRAIGHT to my face saying I have no clue what you're talking about I did not do that, luckily I took screenshots & videos prior. That's the type of person he was. But he likes to act like he's the good guy by trying to get close to you, "being his streamer friend". I remember at times I would gamble on the site, sometimes win tens of thousands and his whole tone would change so clear that he wouldn't like it when I would win but of course would ask for some "juice" for giving the marker 😂, I don't expect much from a past gambling streamer & gambling addict they hire for their site. What a rat.

Could you imagine I was down 600K USD, 8.8M USD wagered, and my 90d bonus for it was 1.1K on stream. I argued with it and was promised good rewarding for such loss instead after days of delay the response from the VIP guy was there is absolutely nothing to add. I genuinely have no clue what the sites problem is but they have absolutely zero streamers left I wouldn't be surprised if they are just planning to go out of business and get their quick money.

Moral of the Story please stay away from this hell of a website. It's reputation is absolutely tarnished and it IS NOT the place to throw your money or work with.

As of for me, I'm no longer ever and I mean EVER working with these smaller end websites, will be in search of working with only the best, and most popular websites I think I've learned my lesson already. Pathetic.
